title: Extract congress member names from text — extractMemberName
text: data data frame variable (specified col_name) containing text members congress extracted. Can also character vector containing text, converted data frame. col_name character; data data frame, name variable containing congress members' names. data character vector, name given variable containing original text output (unspecified, "speaker" used). members regex table containing variations congress member names. default, members dataset accompanying package used. table must following columns: typos dataset extract typos. default, typos dataset accompanying package used. table must following columns: congress name variable data containing congress row, vector congress numbers row. single value supplied, applied rows. argument required. chamber name variable data containing chamber row, character vector containing chamber row. single value supplied, applied rows. Allowable values include values members, , default, "Senate", "House", "President". NA values allowed incorporated match. argument optional. See Details. state name variable data containing state row, character vector containing state row. single value supplied, applied rows. Allowable values include two-letter abbreviations state (e.g., "MA") well "USA" rows corresponding presidents, full names states (e.g., "Massachusetts"). NA values allowed incorporated match. argument optional. See Details. fix_ocr logical; whether fix OCR errors. Passed fix_typos(). verbose logical; whether display information process extracting names, including progress bars. cl cluster object created parallel::makeCluster(), integer indicate number child-processes (integer values ignored Windows) parallel evaluations. Passed pbapply::pblapply().

title: Extract congress member names from text — extractMemberName
